description: A 2HP stereo delay: two delay lines sharing one set of controls, with the right input normalled to the left so one cable gives a plain mono delay

params.text: Sets the delay, 1ms to 2 seconds, squared across the knob's travel so the short times take most of it
Sets how much of the delayed signal is fed back into the line, 0% to 98%
Crossfades between the dry input and the delayed signal, all dry fully counter-clockwise and all wet fully clockwise

inputs.text: Moves the delay, a tenth of the time knob's travel per volt, the total held within the knob's range; the read point glides to the new time rather than jumping to it
The audio into the left delay line
The audio into the right delay line; unpatched it reads the L in jack

outputs.text: The left input crossfaded with the output of the left delay line
The right input crossfaded with the output of the right delay line

notes: both audio inputs take polyphony and both outputs carry as many channels as the wider of the two, each channel getting its own pair of delay lines

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the L in jack.
